items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Kit Howard used to come by and Howard, well, he tried to show me a lot of it.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I'd get tired holding it up in there. So, yeah. So I'd decide that I'd learn to take up drums. Learn drums. Well, at the time of learning the drums, Kit Howard used to come by and Howard, well, he tried to show me a lot of it.
Well, he'd been playing drums, hadn't he?
